raw_text: The G20 Modi-Xi handshake image incident provides a compelling case study for our ongoing research into AI-generated political imagery and its impact on democratic processes. Our analysis demonstrates that consumer-accessible text-to-image models can now generate photorealistic political imagery indistinguishable from authentic press photography at casual viewing distances. The rapid virality of this image — reaching an estimated 10 million WhatsApp users within 18 hours — underscores the asymmetry between generation speed and verification speed. We propose a framework for classifying AI-generated political content by intent, distribution mechanism, and potential for electoral influence. This case, while ultimately benign in origin, previews the challenges that 2024 election cycles worldwide will face.
